---
title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Maxine Paredes"
date: 2026-09-10
---

![First day of school!](first_week.jpg)

We are now in our second week of the MDS program and I have been enjoying my time so far. While it holds up to its reputation as an accelerated program, I feel supported by the teaching team and am already learning so much.

Even in the short amount of time I have been in the program, I can see that immersion and consistency will play a large role in success. The different ways of exposure to new material allows us to both solidfy our understand and identify areas of improvement from various angles.

 The immediate volume of work took me by surprise but I am also impressed by the amount of resources that are available to me. I am still trying to find the balance between school, relationships, health and wellness, clubs, and research but I am so excited for the opportunity to grow and build my skills.
